description: For the RECEIVER of a handoff (delegate_task): report the result back. status done | partial | blocked, result = what was done / found (the data the sender needs). If the sender waits (wait_for_result) its session is resumed with this result automatically. questions: open points only a human can decide — they are collected in the SENDER's delegation, not scattered. Call this once when finished, instead of a delegate_task back to the sender.

delegation_id.description: The handoff id (from the task text).

questions.description: Open points only a human can decide, collected in the sender's delegation

result.description: What was done or found, the data the sender needs

status.description: Outcome of the handed-over task: done, partial or blocked

name: report_task_result
